text.p: Bulgaria boosted their prospects of making the 1998 World Cup finals by beating Cyprus 3-1 in Limassol on Saturday to go second in their group.
The Bulgarians adjusted quickly to the heavy pitch and took the lead after 23 minutes, Krassimir Balakov capitalising on a misunderstanding in the Cyprus defence before firing home from close range.
Cyprus responded six minutes later with a free-kick goal from captain Pambos Pittas.
Balakov scored his second and restored Bulgaria's lead after 34 minutes and Ilian Iliev wrapped up the victory for the 1994 World Cup semifinalists with a second half goal.
Cyprus squandered a chance to claw themselves back into the game when Sinica Gogic missed a 75th minute penalty.
